content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] enthusiasts, The [company_name] Internet page has just been updated. [url] The link to download the [product_name] mobile app (Android and iOS), as well as a description, is now included. Regards
Hi [user_name], that link currently shows an error.
Hello, I have edited the link from [user_name]. It should work now. Best regards, [user_name]

I discovered some tips when connecting the iOS app to my [product_name] on the local area network. The most important step is to enter 'App User' as the username in the app. Also, turn off your cellphone to avoid it searching for local network IPs on the internet, which helps if you are only using a local connection through Wi-Fi. If you have a VPN running on your laptop, turn that off too.

Dear [company_name], I'd like to know why it is not possible to download this app in my country. The associated hardware is widely used in universities and for simple projects here. Is it possible to enable the app download in this region? Best regards, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], this is a forum, not an official contact channel for [company_name] Support. If you want to get in touch with [company_name] directly, please submit a Support Request.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the accessibility of the [product_name] mobile app. Concerns include non-functional web links, local network setup difficulties, and restrictions preventing downloads in certain countries despite demand. The conversation also covers tips for setup and troubleshooting connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] app and guidance to be easily accessible with working download links, and for the app to be available in all regions where the hardware is commonly used. They also look for clear, detailed instructions for both network setup and app configuration.
